SET	@prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ht_death_age(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) DEFAULT NULL,
	pt_group1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	death_group1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pt_group2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	death_group2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pt_group3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	death_group3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pt_group4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	death_group4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pt_group5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	death_group5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)

) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ht_death_age WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ht_death_age 
(
SELECT
	@id,p.hospcode,p.vhid,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
	,b1,a1,b2,a2,b3,a3,b4,a4,b5,a5
FROM
		(			SELECT d_hospcode as hospcode,d_pt_vhid as vhid
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='1'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b1
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  as b2
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b3
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b4
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b5
				FROM
						(SELECT	* FROM t_chronic
							WHERE	nation=99 AND d_typearea in(1,3)
									AND substr(d_pt_vhid,1,2)=@prov_c
									AND substr(diagcode,1,3) BETWEEN 'I10' AND 'I15'
							GROUP BY cid ) as pt
				GROUP BY
						d_hospcode,d_pt_vhid
		) as p LEFT JOIN
		(SELECT person_hospcode hospcode , check_vhid vhid 
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='1'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a1
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  as a2
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a3
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a4
						,SUM(CASE WHEN groupcode='5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a5
			FROM
(SELECT a.*
from
(
SELECT	p.HOSPCODE person_hospcode ,p.PID person_pid,p.cid,p.`NAME`,p.LNAME,p.BIRTH,p.age_y,p.SEX,p.NATION,p.check_vhid,groupcode
,c.input_hosp,c.input_pid,c.source_tb ,c.diagcode,c.date_dx,c.hosp_dx
,c.typedisch chronic_disch ,d.HOSPCODE death_input, d.HOSPDEATH,d.ddeath,d.cdeath
FROM t_chronic c 
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON c.cid=p.CID
INNER JOIN (SELECT cid ,ddeath,cdeath,HOSPCODE,HOSPDEATH
									FROM t_death 
									WHERE substr(cdeath,1,1) not in('V','X','S') 
									AND DATE_FORMAT(ddeath,'%Y%m%d')  BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d   
									)		 as d ON c.cid=d.cid
WHERE	p.nation=99 AND p.check_typearea in(1,3) 
									AND substr(d_pt_vhid,1,2)=@prov_c
									AND substr(diagcode,1,3) BETWEEN 'I10' AND 'I15'
UNION
SELECT	p.HOSPCODE person_hospcode ,p.PID person_pid,p.cid,p.`NAME`,p.LNAME,p.BIRTH,p.age_y,p.SEX,p.NATION,p.check_vhid,groupcode
,c.input_hosp,c.input_pid,c.source_tb ,c.diagcode,c.date_dx,c.hosp_dx
,c.typedisch,c.p_hospcode input_death_hosp,null,c.datedisch,NULL
FROM t_chronic c 
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON c.cid=p.CID
WHERE	p.nation=99 AND p.check_typearea in(1,3) 
									AND substr(d_pt_vhid,1,2)=@prov_c
									AND substr(diagcode,1,3) BETWEEN 'I10' AND 'I15'
									AND (typedisch=2 AND datedisch BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ) 
	) as a
GROUP BY a.cid
ORDER BY cid
) b
GROUP BY person_hospcode,check_vhid
 ) as d		ON p.hospcode=d.hospcode and p.vhid = d.vhid
		WHERE substr(p.vhid,1,2)=@prov_c		
		GROUP BY p.hospcode,p.vhid

);
rows.aname: จำนวนผู้ป่วยด้วยโรคความดันโลหิตสูงเสียชีวิต
rows.bname: จำนวนป่วยด้วยโรคความดันโลหิตสูงทั้งหมด
rows.notice:
- ผู้ป่วยโรคความดันโลหิตสูง รหัส ICD10 3 หลักแรก เป็น I10-I15
- ผู้ป่วยโรคความดันโลหิตสูง เสียชีวิต จากแฟ้ม DEATH , SERVICE , ADMISSION ที่จำหน่ายเสียชีวิต เชื่อมโยงด้วยเลขบัตรประชาชน
- ไม่นับที่เสียชีวิตจาก รหัส ICD10 ที่ขึ้นต้นด้วยตัวอักษรดังนี้ V,X,S
- รายงานนี้ไม่ใช่รายงานสรุปสาเหตุการเสียชีวิต เป็นเพียงรายงานว่า ผู้ป่วยโรคความดันโลหิตสูงเสียชีวิต

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("death_group1") as "result1" ,SUM("death_group2") as "result2" ,SUM("death_group3") as "result3" ,SUM("death_group4") as "result4" ,SUM("death_group5") as "result5" ,SUM("pt_group1") as "target1" ,SUM("pt_group2") as "target2" ,SUM("pt_group3") as "target3" ,SUM("pt_group4") as "target4" ,SUM("pt_group5") as "target5" ,SUM("pt_group1"+"pt_group2"+"pt_group3"+"pt_group4"+"pt_group5") as "target" ,SUM("death_group1"+"death_group2"+"death_group3"+"death_group4"+"death_group5") as "result"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
